diagnosis: Frozen generic separator implementation required every post-separator clause group to contain at least 3 clauses. Valid v1.1 local gadgets (especially compact 2CNF leaves and Horn private islands) violate that heuristic, so no candidate admitted calibration formulas. Removing only the minimum-clause heuristic still exposed leaf-intersection cliques because some local gadgets fragment around the same separator.
disposition: v1.1 terminates. No rho frozen. No blind run. Continue only under new prereg/new independently generated population with structurally robust local gadgets; frozen transfer_core remains unchanged unless separately preregistered.
